name: creative-ai-tools
description: Claude plugins for the AI creative tools in this repository

plugins.name: youtube-scout
plugins.description: YouTube research with the official YouTube Data API: long-tail keywords, what to make next from viewer comments, similar-size collaborators and title checks. Ships the read-only yt tool.

plugins.name: video-production
plugins.description: Edit a video into a long-form (16:9) and a short-form (9:16) deliverable with a Shotcut project behind each: rough cut from raw footage, subtitles, safe areas, export and render checks.
